methodology.precision: FP32, TF32 disabled, fixed shapes, fixed random seed, no AMP
methodology.gpu_interval: CUDA-event interval. May include submission gaps. It is not an isolated instruction count or an occupancy measurement.
methodology.overhead: Paired wall minus CUDA-event time includes Python/C ABI dispatch, event instrumentation and synchronization. Reported as aggregate overhead, not a pure launch latency.
methodology.cpu_efficiency: T1/(p*Tp) for the same native CPU convolution at p OpenMP workers. It does not define efficiency for heterogeneous GPU cores.
methodology.transfer: Pageable host buffers and preallocated copy destinations. Host-to-host convolution includes allocations and both transfers.
methodology.cost: Logical tensor bytes and FLOPs are calculated. Process RSS and GPU tensor allocation are measured. Energy and monetary cost remain null without power telemetry and a configured price.
methodology.statistics: One local experiment, repeated latency samples. p10/p90 describe timing spread, not independent training-run uncertainty.
